correctness.rationale: Root-in-all-maximum-independent-sets iff no child is essential. The increasing-tree SET recursion gives E' = exp(T-E), hence exp(E)=1+L and the marked EGF exactly. Uniform complex logarithmic transfer on a delta-domain yields the inverse-gamma factor and O(1/log n) relative remainder, whose derivatives give the stated mean/variance. Exact enumerations through n=8 and n=1000 numerical diagnostics check normalization, moment formulas, and asymptotic consistency. Independent global maximum-set enumeration catches a potential misinterpretation of essentiality. These finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Root rigidity in maximum independent sets is a natural nonlocal optimization event, and root degree is the fundamental local connectivity statistic for growing recursive trees. This theorem quantifies the rare-event reweighting by a diverging loglog degree deficit and captures all conditional cumulants via a single inverse-Gamma mod-Poisson law, going materially beyond known global independence-number densities and root probabilities.
